name: add_attachment
description: Attach one more file to a saved draft, keeping its recipients, subject, body and thread. The draft gets a new message_id. For several files, pass a list of parameter objects in a single run_plugin_tool call so they run one after another: parallel calls on the same draft lose attachments.

draft_id.description: The draft to add the file to, from create_draft.

file.description: The file to attach. All attachments on the draft must stay under 25 MB together.
